note: This increment adds C11, unknown-subsection, column and filename-bound tests. The C13 parser is unchanged.
covered: a module's C13ByteSize is read after its symbol and C11 bytes; C11-only data produces procedures without source lines and C11+C13 together invalidates the PDB
DEBUG_S_LINES, DEBUG_S_FILECHKSMS and DEBUG_S_STRINGTABLE are consumed; other well-framed subsection kinds are skipped safely
checksum filenames resolve through the module string table or the PDB /names global string table
a line block's name index must be a checksum-record boundary
one-based PE sections, relocation offsets, code size and line offsets resolve against an executable section
source locations attach to procedures from that module, span to the next offset or contribution end and are clipped to the procedure range
columns are structurally parsed and omitted from the returned symbol fields
filename spelling is preserved without path normalization
boundaries of 65536 subsections, 1000000 source lines, 65536 checksum files, 1000000 line mappings and 4096-byte names are enforced
invalid framing, missing strings/checksums, invalid ranges and decreasing line offsets return no partial symbols
limits: Legacy MSF, Portable PDB and demangling remain outside this slice.
No final image, public CI or external SDK crash was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
